verses.ar: بِسۡمِ اللّٰہِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِیۡمِ ﴿۱﴾
verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.

verses.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَۃُ وَانۡشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ ﴿۲﴾
verses.en: The Hour has drawn nigh, and the moon is rent asunder.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ یَّرَوۡا اٰیَۃً یُّعۡرِضُوۡا وَیَقُوۡلُوۡا سِحۡرٌ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ ﴿۳﴾
verses.en: And if they see a Sign, they turn away and say, ‘A passing feat of magic.’

verses.ar: وَکَذَّبُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡۤا اَہۡوَآءَہُمۡ وَکُلُّ اَمۡرٍ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: They reject the truth and follow their own fancies. But every decree of God shall certainly come to pass.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَہُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۡۢبَآءِ مَا فِیۡہِ مُزۡدَجَرٌ ۙ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: And there has already come to them the great news wherein is a warning —

verses.ar: حِکۡمَۃٌۢ بَالِغَۃٌ فَمَا تُغۡنِ النُّذُرُ ۙ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: Consummate wisdom; but the warnings profit them not.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡہُمۡ ۘ یَوۡمَ یَدۡعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰی شَیۡءٍ نُّکُرٍ ۙ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: Therefore turn thou away from them. The day when the Summoner will summon them to a disagreeable thing,

verses.ar: خُشَّعًا اَبۡصَارُہُمۡ یَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ کَاَنَّہُمۡ جَرَادٌ مُّنۡتَشِرٌ ۙ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: While their eyes will be cast down and they will come forth from their graves as though they were locusts scattered about,

verses.ar: مُّہۡطِعِیۡنَ اِلَی الدَّاعِ ؕ یَقُوۡلُ الۡکٰفِرُوۡنَ ہٰذَا یَوۡمٌ عَسِرٌ ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: Hastening towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will say, ‘This is a hard day.’

verses.ar: کَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَہُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ فَکَذَّبُوۡا عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُوۡا مَجۡنُوۡنٌ وَّازۡدُجِرَ ﴿۱۰﴾
verses.en: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them; aye, they rejected Our servant and said, ‘A madman and one who is spurned.’

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّہٗۤ اَنِّیۡ مَغۡلُوۡبٌ فَانۡتَصِرۡ ﴿۱۱﴾
verses.en: He therefore prayed to his Lord saying, ‘I am overcome, so come Thou to my help!’

verses.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَاۤ اَبۡوَابَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنۡہَمِرٍ ﴿۫ۖ۱۲﴾
verses.en: Thereupon We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring down;

verses.ar: وَّفَجَّرۡنَا الۡاَرۡضَ عُیُوۡنًا فَالۡتَقَی الۡمَآءُ عَلٰۤی اَمۡرٍ قَدۡ قُدِرَ ﴿ۚ۱۳﴾
verses.en: And We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, so the two waters met for a purpose that was decreed.
w: and We caused  to burst forth

verses.ar: وَحَمَلۡنٰہُ عَلٰی ذَاتِ اَلۡوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍ ﴿ۙ۱۴﴾
verses.en: And We carried him upon that which was made of planks and nails.

verses.ar: تَجۡرِیۡ بِاَعۡیُنِنَا ۚ جَزَآءً لِّمَنۡ کَانَ کُفِرَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: It floated on under Our eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ تَّرَکۡنٰہَاۤ اٰیَۃً فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿۱۶﴾
verses.en: And We left it as a Sign for the coming generations; but is there anyone who would receive admonition?
w: as a Sign for the coming generations

verses.ar: فَکَیۡفَ کَانَ عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۱۷﴾
verses.en: How terrible then was My punishment and My warning!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ یَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّکۡرِ فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿۱۸﴾
verses.en: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy to understand and to remember. But is there anyone who would receive admonition?

verses.ar: کَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ فَکَیۡفَ کَانَ عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۱۹﴾
verses.en: The tribe of ‘Ad rejected the truth. How terrible then was My punishment and My warning!

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ رِیۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِیۡ یَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّ ﴿ۙ۲۰﴾
verses.en: We sent against them a furious wind on a day of unending ill luck,

verses.ar: تَنۡزِعُ النَّاسَ ۙ کَاَنَّہُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ مُّنۡقَعِرٍ ﴿۲۱﴾
verses.en: Tearing people away as though they were the trunks of uprooted palm-trees.

verses.ar: فَکَیۡفَ کَانَ عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: How terrible then was My punishment and My warning!

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ یَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّکۡرِ فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿٪۲۳﴾
verses.en: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy to understand and to remember. But is there anyone who would receive admonition?

verses.ar: کَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِالنُّذُرِ ﴿۲۴﴾
verses.en: The tribe of Thamud also rejected the Warners.

verses.ar: فَقَالُوۡۤا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُہٗۤ ۙ اِنَّاۤ اِذًا لَّفِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: And they said, ‘What! a man, from among ourselves, a single individual! Shall we follow him? [✲]Then indeed we would be in manifest error, and would be mad.

verses.ar: ءَاُلۡقِیَ الذِّکۡرُ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡۢ بَیۡنِنَا بَلۡ ہُوَ کَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ ﴿۲۶﴾
verses.en: ‘Has the Reminder been revealed to him alone of all of us? Nay, he is a boastful liar.’

verses.ar: سَیَعۡلَمُوۡنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الۡکَذَّابُ الۡاَشِرُ ﴿۲۷﴾
verses.en: ‘Tomorrow will they know who is the boastful liar!

verses.ar: اِنَّا مُرۡسِلُوا النَّاقَۃِ فِتۡنَۃً لَّہُمۡ فَارۡتَقِبۡہُمۡ وَاصۡطَبِرۡ ﴿۫۲۸﴾
verses.en: ‘We will send the she-camel as a trial for them. So watch them, O Salih, and have patience.

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئۡہُمۡ اَنَّ الۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَۃٌۢ بَیۡنَہُمۡ ۚ کُلُّ شِرۡبٍ مُّحۡتَضَرٌ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘And tell them that the water is shared only between them, but as for the she-camel every drinking time may be attended by her.’

verses.ar: فَنَادَوۡا صَاحِبَہُمۡ فَتَعَاطٰی فَعَقَرَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]But they called their comrade, and he seized a sword and hamstrung her.

verses.ar: فَکَیۡفَ کَانَ عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۳۱﴾
verses.en: How terrible then was My punishment and My warning!

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ صَیۡحَۃً وَّاحِدَۃً فَکَانُوۡا کَہَشِیۡمِ الۡمُحۡتَظِرِ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: We sent against them a single blast, and they became like the dry stubble, trampled upon.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ یَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّکۡرِ فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿۳۳﴾
verses.en: And indeed We have made the Qur’an easy to understand and to remember. But is there anyone who would receive admonition?

verses.ar: کَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍۭ بِالنُّذُرِ ﴿۳۴﴾
verses.en: Lot’s people also rejected the Warners.

verses.ar: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ حَاصِبًا اِلَّاۤ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍ ؕ نَجَّیۡنٰہُمۡ بِسَحَرٍ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: We sent a storm of stones upon them except the family of Lot, whom We delivered by early dawn,

verses.ar: نِّعۡمَۃً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَا ؕ کَذٰلِکَ نَجۡزِیۡ مَنۡ شَکَرَ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: As a favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who is grateful.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَنۡذَرَہُمۡ بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡا بِالنُّذُرِ ﴿۳۷﴾
verses.en: And he indeed had warned them of Our punishment, but they doubted the warning.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدُوۡہُ عَنۡ ضَیۡفِہٖ فَطَمَسۡنَاۤ اَعۡیُنَہُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۳۸﴾
verses.en: And they deceitfully sought to turn him away from his guests. So We blinded their eyes, and said, ‘Taste ye now My punishment and My warning.’
w: they deceitfully sought to turn him away

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَہُمۡ بُکۡرَۃً عَذَابٌ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ ﴿ۚ۳۹﴾
verses.en: And there came upon them early in the morning a lasting punishment.
w: there came upon them in the morning

verses.ar: فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِیۡ وَنُذُرِ ﴿۴۰﴾
verses.en: ‘Now taste ye My punishment and My warning.’

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ یَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّکۡرِ فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿٪۴۱﴾
verses.en: And, indeed, We have made the Qur’an easy to understand and to remember. But is there anyone who would receive admonition?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ النُّذُرُ ﴿ۚ۴۲﴾
verses.en: And surely to the people of Pharaoh also came Warners.

verses.ar: کَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰیٰتِنَا کُلِّہَا فَاَخَذۡنٰہُمۡ اَخۡذَ عَزِیۡزٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: They rejected all Our Signs. So We seized them like the seizing of One Who is Mighty and Omnipotent.

verses.ar: اَکُفَّارُکُمۡ خَیۡرٌ مِّنۡ اُولٰٓئِکُمۡ اَمۡ لَکُمۡ بَرَآءَۃٌ فِی الزُّبُرِ ﴿ۚ۴۴﴾
verses.en: Are your disbelievers better than those? Or have you an exemption in the Scriptures?

verses.ar: اَمۡ یَقُوۡلُوۡنَ نَحۡنُ جَمِیۡعٌ مُّنۡتَصِرٌ ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: Do they say, ‘We are a victorious host?’

verses.ar: سَیُہۡزَمُ الۡجَمۡعُ وَیُوَلُّوۡنَ الدُّبُرَ ﴿۴۶﴾
verses.en: The hosts shall soon be routed and will turn their backs in flight.

verses.ar: بَلِ السَّاعَۃُ مَوۡعِدُہُمۡ وَالسَّاعَۃُ اَدۡہٰی وَاَمَرُّ ﴿۴۷﴾
verses.en: Aye, the Hour is their appointed time; and the Hour will be most calamitous and most bitter.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِیۡنَ فِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ ﴿ۘ۴۸﴾
verses.en: Surely, the guilty are in manifest error and gone mad.

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ یُسۡحَبُوۡنَ فِی النَّارِ عَلٰی وُجُوۡہِہِمۡ ؕ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَسَّ سَقَرَ ﴿۴۹﴾
verses.en: On the day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, and it will be said to them, ‘Taste ye the touch of Hell.’
w: and it will be said to them, taste ye

verses.ar: اِنَّا کُلَّ شَیۡءٍ خَلَقۡنٰہُ بِقَدَرٍ ﴿۵۰﴾
verses.en: Verily, We have created everything in due measure.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَمۡرُنَاۤ اِلَّا وَاحِدَۃٌ کَلَمۡحٍۭ بِالۡبَصَرِ ﴿۵۱﴾
verses.en: And Our command is carried out by only one word, like the twinkling of an eye.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَہۡلَکۡنَاۤ اَشۡیَاعَکُمۡ فَہَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّکِرٍ ﴿۵۲﴾
verses.en: And indeed We have destroyed people before you who were like unto you. But is there anyone who would receive admonition?
w: people before you who were like unto you

verses.ar: وَکُلُّ شَیۡءٍ فَعَلُوۡہُ فِی الزُّبُرِ ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: And everything they have done is recorded in the Books.

verses.ar: وَکُلُّ صَغِیۡرٍ وَّکَبِیۡرٍ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ ﴿۵۴﴾
verses.en: And every matter, small and great, is written down.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِیۡنَ فِیۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَہَرٍ ﴿ۙ۵۵﴾
verses.en: Verily, the righteous will be in the midst of Gardens and streams,
w: will be in the midst of

verses.ar: فِیۡ مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِنۡدَ مَلِیۡکٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ ﴿٪۵۶﴾
verses.en: In the seat of truth with an Omnipotent King.
